name: Second and Third Partitions of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (1793–1795) (C0037)

techniques.comment: The seizure and incorporation into the empire of Right-Bank Ukraine, Volhynia, and Podillia: Russia received "the Kyiv, Bratslav, and Podillia voivodeships and the eastern half of the Volhynian voivodeship," and under the third partition – "the western part of the Volhynian voivodeship, the western parts of the Kholm land and the Belz voivodeship"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 8 2011).

The diplomatic collusion of the great powers behind the backs of the peoples of the dismembered republic: "Russia carried out the second partition of Poland jointly with Prussia"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 8 2011); all three monarchies took part in the third – the fate of the Right Bank was decided in St. Petersburg, Berlin, and Vienna.
